text:
Anna L: Quick check on trace panel export UX — the button currently says 'Export'. Suggest 'Export traces' and surface format (JSON / CSV) in the modal. Agree? Devin R: +1. Also a11y: when modal opens focus should go to format selector, not the close X. Micah P: Also change stack trace 'Copy' to 'Copy stack trace' and copy plain text (not HTML). Support pastes break otherwise. Liz C: Prefer label 'Trace ID' (not 'Correlation ID') with tooltip 'Unique identifier for this request/trace'. Keep tooltip concise. a11y-bot: Add aria-live="polite" on success toast, trap focus in modal, return focus to trigger, and ensure dropdown has aria-label and arrow-key nav. Tooltip should use aria-describedby. Devin R: Example toast:
Export complete \r\n42 traces. Download
Micah P: Server note: set content-disposition for download. Test payload: POST /api/traces/export {"format":"json","filter":"error:true","limit":50}. Will sanitize copied stacks (strip zero-width chars). Anna L: Layout q: should Export be in overflow or visible on toolbar? Support uses it often 1. I propose main toolbar with small chevron and last-used-format pill. Liz C: Keep header short: 'Export traces'. Show format selector in modal. Anna L: Owners: Anna 03update Figma & copy; Devin 03modal focus & aria-live; Micah 03headers & sanitize; Liz 03final copy review; a11y-bot 03verify ARIA. Target: EOD Wed. Devin R: QA item: keyboard only flow: open modal, change format, press Enter, confirm toast announced and focus returns to export button. Anna L: Thanks! I'll open tasks and link PRs when ready.
